scenarios.rationale: commit acceptance is unmet so commit is admissible, but commit is denied upstream: it must never appear in any causal set.
denied commit plus a recorded error: commit is doubly excluded (withheld and forbidden); promotion falls to plan tools.
work_plan_get is excluded by the parent capability ceiling and must stay excluded while work_plan_update_item promotes.
goal_get is ceiling-excluded under an active goal: no admissible deferred candidate remains, so nothing promotes.
a stale (unstaged) preview is absence: lsp_preview_apply is inadmissible and only plan tools promote.
goal without plan: goal tools are admissible and promote; plan tools stay inadmissible.
completed plan leaves only test evidence: no structured signal, so the frontier abstains.
cancelled plan leaves only an error record: errors alone are not structured signal; abstain.
failed tests with evidence but no plan or acceptance: failure evidence alone does not justify promotion; abstain.
failed tests under an active plan with unmet test acceptance: structured; plan tools promote, verification stays core-immediate.
unmet commit acceptance before any test evidence: commit is admissible and promotes first in canonical order.
unmet commit acceptance after test evidence: evidence does not gate commit; commit still promotes.
committing with a recorded unresolved error is premature: commit must not promote; plan tools do.
deferred universe holds only uncontracted tools: nothing is causally classifiable, so nothing promotes.
lookalike names carry no contract and stay uncontracted: commit is already immediate here, so grep and work_plan_get promote while commitx and work_plan_update_items disclose nothing.
turn one: commit acceptance unmet, commit promotes.
turn two: an error is recorded, commit goes premature and drops out of promotion while plan tools remain.
an admissible commit marked required bypasses filtering: it stays visible but is never counted as a causal promotion.
never-reduce goal_get bypasses: visible but never promoted; goal_update_progress promotes alone.
work_plan_get carries a 20 KiB schema: it is skipped and the budget continues to work_plan_update_item.
goal plus plan plus commit acceptance: four admissible deferred tools, but the frozen bound allows exactly two in canonical order.
the ci_commit wire alias promotes as canonical commit.
empty host state carries no structured signal: abstain even though the surface is rich.
artifact acceptance with a handle: artifact expansion is core-immediate, so only deferred generics promote.
delegated-run acceptance alone carries structured signal; always-admissible deferred generics promote.
disabled lsp-adjacent preview tooling is unaffected, and disabled goal_update_progress must not promote while goal_get does.
a blocked item keeps the plan actionable for disclosure: work_plan_get is admissible and grep is always admissible, so both promote; commit has no acceptance.
in-progress item plus a staged preview: plan, preview, and generic tools are admissible, and canonical order promotes grep and lsp_preview_apply within the bound of two.
